result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, with the oldest first within each priority. The full test suite passes. I didn't add a test for the T-1 to T-5 example.

The change is in `SupportTicketStore.listOpenInRegion` (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/SupportTicketStore.java`). It now uses the same priority-then-oldest ordering as `listOpenOfSalesRep`. I also updated its Javadoc. Closed tickets and other regions' tickets are excluded as before.

The only caller of this method is `RegionManagerService`, so nothing else changes order.
